summary: Completed testing of Instance Scoping Bug Fix and Delete Functionality. Backend: 8/8 tests passed. Frontend: All features verified working correctly. New bots have clean/default settings and empty KB. Delete buttons for bots, orgs, and users are present and functional.

issues: Custom Instructions textarea shows placeholder text 'Always respond in English...' which could be confused with actual data - consider using a lighter placeholder style

critical_code_review_comments: Instance scoping fix working correctly: AuthContext.selectBot creates synthetic instance for V2 bots without legacy_instance_id
New bots correctly get default persona ('You are a helpful, friendly, and knowledgeable assistant.') not inherited from other bots
New bots correctly have 0 KB articles (not inherited from legacy bots)
Delete org API (DELETE /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}) cascades to bots, connections, accounts, templates
Delete org button correctly hidden when only 1 org exists, visible when 2+ orgs
User delete buttons present on Team & Access page (data-testid='delete-user-{id}')
Bot list updates immediately after creating a bot (no page refresh needed)
seed_data_creation: Test bots and orgs created with TEST_ prefix and cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Instance scoping bug fix verified working. Key implementation: AuthContext.selectBot (line 200-218) creates synthetic instance {id: bot.id, name: bot.name} for V2 bots without legacy_instance_id. This ensures bf_instance_id in localStorage is set to the bot's own ID, which scopes KB articles and settings correctly. Delete functionality: DELETE /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/bots/{bot_id} for bots, DELETE /api/v2/orgs/{org_id} for orgs (cascades). Delete org button only visible when orgs.length > 1 (AdminLayout.js line 356).
